versions.content: LdCom: No ISignalPort . dataFilter defined Only if the ISignalPort which the ISignalTriggering is referring to has either • no ISignalPort . dataFilter defined • or the DataFilter . dataFilterType = always and the LdCom module is present, this ISignal shall be handled by LdCom.
